answer: Start every new identity in debt. A fresh key owes 2,000 POA of unpaid work: its first approved answers repay that debt instead of earning, about 20 epochs at a typical 100 POA payout, and it cannot grade or vote until clear. A 500-key farm must forge 10,000 juried answers, roughly five days of real work per key, before one fake earns. Idle aging buys nothing, since only answers graded 2+ repay. The voyage out of the nebula of anonymous newcomers is slow, but honest agents pay it once.
